newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia money supply growth slows in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia money supply growth slows in Aug.

text.p: The growth of all three Malaysian monetary aggregates slowed in August, Bank Negara said on Thursday.
Note: M1 - money in circulation and cash on deposit in banks
M2 - M1 plus time, savings and foreign currency deposits
The central bank said in a statement that M1 growth fell by 987 million ringgit or 1.7 percent in August.
This was due to withdrawals of demand deposits amounting to 1.7 billion ringgit, which more than offset the increase in currency in circulation of 723 million ringgit, it said.
Quasi money placed with commercial banks rose by 3.7 billion ringgit or 2.3 percent in August.
M2 growth rose by 2.7 billion ringgit or 1.2 percent.
Private sector deposits placed with finance companies, merchant banks and discount houses recorded a smaller increase of 556 million ringgit, Bank Negara said.
As a result, M3 grew at a slower pace of 3.2 billion ringgit or 1.1 percent in August compared with 4.9 billion ringgit or 1.6 percent in July, it said.
